title: Innistrad: Midnight Hunt Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who sensed a plot and raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A warrior who takes no joy in violence but cares only for the lives he saves.

entities.name: Lier, Disciple of the Drowned
entities.description: A disciple of the Drowned, connected to lost gods stirring beneath the waves.

entities.name: Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia
entities.description: A ghoulcaller who raises the drowned dead from the river to serve him.

entities.name: Ormendahl, the Corrupter
entities.description: A demon who addresses Jerren as a faithful, useful insect.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: An evil being whose legacy lives on through a mask.

entities.name: Mask of Griselbrand
entities.description: A mask carrying the legacy of Griselbrand's evil.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: A werewolf whose huntmaster leads a pack that smells fear and despair.

entities.name: Katilda, Dawnhart Prime
entities.description: A leader of the Dawnhart witches who trusts in Ghrin-Danu after the angels' abandonment.

entities.name: Ghrin-Danu
entities.description: A power Katilda says has not abandoned the people.

entities.name: Dawnhart
entities.description: A coven of witches who call on nature.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A province of narrow ravines where howlpacks herd their prey.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A province associated with rivers and the drowned.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: A vampire bloodline whose members fight in the arena.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel whose name is borne by the Sigardian Savior.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A gothic horror plane where day and night cycles have become unspooled.

events.summary: Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt sensing a plot, but someone else had gotten there first.
events.quote: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt. But someone else had gotten there first.

events.summary: Jadar raises a drowned corpse from the river to serve him.
events.quote: "Rise, my pretty thing. Why rot in the river when you can serve at my bidding?"

events.summary: Ormendahl addresses his faithful servant Jerren.
events.quote: "Ah. Jerren. You've been such a faithful, useful insect."

relations.note: Ormendahl calls him faithful and useful.
relations.quote: "Ah. Jerren. You've been such a faithful, useful insect."

relations.note: Katilda places her faith in Ghrin-Danu.
relations.quote: "The angels may have abandoned us, but Ghrin-Danu has not."

rejected.summary: Howlpacks herd their prey through Kessig's ravines.
rejected.quote: Cries of panic echo along Kessig's narrow ravines as howlpacks herd their prey.
